text:
Elliot (CS): quick async standup for Kestrel account — doing the usual W/ blockers format. TL;DR: renewal op next week, adoption gaps on embeddings + latency spike during peak test.

Elliot (CS): What I did: ran adoption audit, collected logs from the last prod run, opened ticket KEST-412 for embedding mismatch. Blockers: need eng help to validate quant profile; customer wants deterministic latency for demo. Today: follow up w/ eng + prep renewal talking points.

Samir K: on it. I looked at KEST-412 and the model is hitting 95th p99 on the small batch path. Possible culprit: fallback to FP16 kernel during warmup. Can you attach the trace?

Elliot (CS): attached minimal trace in the ticket but pasting snippet here: 
```
2026-03-15T18:24:12Z INFO route=embed model=redwood-m-8qB kernel=fp16 latency_ms=42
2026-03-15T18:24:12Z WARN route=embed batch=1 fallback_to_cpu=false cache_hit=false
```
Not sure if that's warmup churn or config.

Samir K: looks like warmup churn + small-batch inefficiency. Quick ask: can the CS team ask Kestrel to run load test with batch=8 for the demo? That will show steady-state. I can also push a canary quant tweak but need approval.

Jo Park: FYI Kestrel demo is scheduled for Tue 10am PST. I can ask them to accept a short pre-demo run. Also, renewal pricing call is Wed — if we can't guarantee latency numbers we may need to propose a staged SLA.

Priya R: I pinged Kestrel support contact (raj@kestrel.co) for a 30m pre-demo test. They replied they're available Mon afternoon. I also see two adoption items flagged in the success board: onboarding of the embedding search and tutorial feedback on snippet usage.

Samir K: For the canary quant tweak I need a quick rollback plan. deploy-bot, can you summarize the canary policy for Dedicated clusters?

deploy-bot: Canary policy snapshot: 1) deploy to 5% of instances, monitor p95/p99 for 30m, automatic rollback if error rate > 1% or p99 regresses by >20%. Manual rollback allowed via `/canary rollback <id>`. See: https://redwood.internal/runbooks/canary-guide

Elliot (CS): thanks. Samir, if you can open a canary with a short window that'd be great. Also if we don't get stable p99 by Tue demo we should surface fallback options to the customer: pre-warm nodes or set small request throttles.

Samir K: will open canary now and tag the ticket. Can we get access to Kestrel's request profile? embeddings length distribution + avg tokens?

Elliot (CS): pinged Raj for profile. He sent a sample: avg prompt tokens 60, embed length 1536. Sharing in ticket.

Jo Park: Action items: 1) Samir - canary + validation (owner) 2) Priya - confirm Mon pre-demo window with customer (owner) 3) Elliot - draft renewal talking points w/ staged SLA option (owner) 4) Support - prepare quick KB on embedding best practices for Kestrel demo.

Priya R: I'll update the KB and link it here when done. ETA EOD Mon.

Samir K: Canary created: ID canary-17810234, monitoring hooks added to KEST-412. I'll post results in this thread.

Elliot (CS): perfect. If canary looks good, we can offer to include the pre-warm as an add-on for the renewal. Thanks team :thumbsup:

deploy-bot: Canary canary-17810234 started at 2026-03-16T02:10:00Z. Monitoring p95/p99 metrics.

Samir K: initial 30m snapshot shows p99 down from 320ms to 120ms under test batch=8. Looks promising. Posting full metrics to ticket.

Elliot (CS): great update — closing my standup note here, will follow up with renewal draft. If anything urgent ping @Samir K directly.

Jo Park: noted, adding renewal draft to the shared drive and tagging Elliot.

(End of thread)
